jobs.title: Digital Radio IC Design Engineer (F/M/D) 100%
jobs.description:
Facing the Challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful !
The “Integrated and Wireless Systems” Business Unit , based in Neuchâtel, Switzerland is looking for Digital Radio IC Design Engineer.
Your mission
Join our dynamic team of experienced and emerging RF and Timing integrated circuit (IC) designers in the role of a digital radio IC design engineer. Take responsibility for the design of state-of-the-art radio ICs for both industrial and research projects. Be part of our group's mission to push boundaries and tackle challenges of RF and Timing IC design by focusing on innovation through research, development, and collaboration. Join us in shaping the future of RF ICs, providing innovative ultra-low power ICs for short-distance wireless communication systems integrated in deep-submicron CMOS technologies, such as Bluetooth , UWB transceivers for ranging and localization applications, and mm-wave Radar solutions for presence detection, gesture recognition, industrial inspection!
Your responsibilities
- Collaborate with our analog, digital, and RF teams in the development of the next generation radio ICs
- Participate in the specification and architecture definition of the radios
- Design and improve the current radio modem algorithms as well as calibration algorithms for the analog blocks.
- Verify and validate the design through simulations, FPGA implementation, and lab characterization.
- Perform backend tasks such as synthesis, place and route, backannoted simulations, and final verifications.
- Work together with international customers and international universities and research institutes
- Plan and document activities, respecting requirements and deadlines.
- Innovate, think out of the box, challenge yourself.
Your profile
Know-how
- MSc or PhD degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering (electronics, microelectronics)
- Experience in digital IC design
- Knowledge in digital communication principles, modulation schemes, and wireless modem architectures.
- Understanding of radio architectures and its building blocks (analog and digital) as well as the trade-offs in terms of low-power consumption.
- Signal processing skills at hardware and software level for fundamental building blocks like filters, interpolators, FFTs, CORDIC, PID controllers.
- Expertise in HDL languages, especially VHDL.
- Good knowledge of the entire digital flow (from design to backend) for ASICs and FPGAs.
- Understanding of information theory principles like signal entropy, compression algorithms and error correction codes.
- Interested in laboratory measurements.
Interpersonal skills
- An innate curiosity and eagerness to explore, learn, and discover
- Willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges and technologies
- Ability to work effectively in a diverse team, collaborating with both experienced and young IC designers.
- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and engage in practical, hands-on activities to contribute effectively to projects.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- A proactive approach with a focus on achieving tangible outcomes.
- Effective verbal and written communication skills.
- Capable of organizing tasks efficiently, managing time effectively, and maintaining thorough documentation.
- Fluency in English, with French and German also being valued.
CSEM mission and values
Our mission is the development and transfer of innovative technologies to the Swiss industry. Our objective is to make an impact on our customers and on society at large in the fields of precision manufacturing, digital technologies and sustainable energy. Our strength is the excellence of our people, about 600 passionate specialists dedicated to innovation and technology transfer. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- being part of a passionate community
- incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development
- benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback and that favors a work-life balance
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page.
Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

jobs.title: Back2Business Program
jobs.description:
Join our Back2Business program : Relaunch your professional career
Are you a man or woman who has taken a career break for 2 to 5 years and wants to return to the professional world? Do you hold an academic degree in a scientific field within our focus areas (such as low-power electronics, embedded software, machine learning, integrated circuit development, digital technologies, precision manufacturing, sustainable energy, or our expertise ) and are ready to relaunch your professional life?
Our Back2Business program is designed for you!
We offer personalized support to facilitate your return to the job market for up to 6 months.
Join a dynamic community of professionals, benefit from up-to-date training, and give a new boost to your career.
Your Profile
- Women or men with a professional break of 2 to 5 years maximum.
- Academic degree in a technical field: Master or PhD (electrical engineering, communication systems, computer science, etc.).
- Motivation to re-enter the professional life and develop new skills.
- Interest in industrial projects.
- Ability to interact and work in both English and French.
- Candidates must either already reside in the Canton of Neuchâtel or be willing and able to relocate there.
What We Offer
- Possible reintegration on a part-time basis (minimum 50%).
- Training and concrete projects to update your knowledge.
- Personalized coaching to redefine your career path.
- Networking opportunities and integration into innovative industrial projects.
Back2Business – Your career is waiting for you! An initiative supported by

jobs.title: Senior IC Layout Engineer (F/M/D) 100%
jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time - Help us grow and be more impactful!
The “Integrated and Wireless Systems” Business Unit , based in Neuchâtel, Switzerland is looking for a seasoned & creative IC Layout Engineer.
Your mission
You will deliver high-quality IC layout solutions for advanced CMOS projects, with a strong emphasis on innovation and ultra-low-power designs.
As part of an experienced layout team, you will lead top-level integration, verification, and documentation through to successful tape-out.
You will work closely with Project Managers, IC designers, and PhD students on floor-planning and layout execution, including acceptance for fab integration.
This role offers the chance to drive best-in-class IC designs and apply cutting-edge layout techniques and tools.
Scope & success criteria : You own top-level integration layout deliverables (GDS, sign-off checks, and documentation) and support block-level work as needed; success is on-time, first-pass-quality tape-out readiness and smooth handoff for fab integration.
Your responsibilities
Main:
- Execute IC layout tasks (occasionally block-level; primarily top-level integration) through acceptance for integration and tape-out.
- Own chip finishing, verification, version control, documentation, and delivery flow.
- Master layout constraints and floor-planning for advanced CMOS designs.
- Apply best practices for ESD and latch-up, and for analog and RF layout.
- Run LVS/DRC/ERC verification, troubleshoot and debug issues, and support tape-out execution.
- Participate actively in projects to ensure smooth IC layout execution (synchronization, tracking, guidelines, quality, etc.).
- Support project managers and designers in defining and executing layout tasks (preparation, resources, effort, and schedule).
- Maintain IC layout expertise and state-of-the-art techniques (ULP SoC, imager, analog, and RF) for advanced CMOS nodes and foundries, including process features/options, tools, and IT flows.
- Ensure work quality meets the company’s IC design and quality flow, and perform reviews/provide feedback.
- Support designers, partners, customers, and project managers on layout (e.g., Virtuoso) and physical verification tools (e.g., Calibre), and share methodology (matching, low-power routing, RF parasitic avoidance, etc.).
Innovation:
- Contribute to CSEM’s innovation efforts through layout execution, technology choices, and modern CAD techniques, with a focus on ultra-low-power ICs (ULP SoC, imager, analog, and RF).
Your profile
Know-how
- 10+ years’ experience as an Analog/RF IC Layout Engineer (nanometer CMOS).
- Strong experience with Cadence (e.g., Virtuoso) and Siemens verification tools (e.g., Calibre) in production flows.
- Strong hands-on layout experience leading top-level activities for mixed-signal ASICs, from specifications and floor-planning to submitting GDS to the foundry.
- Strong experience with Cadence Virtuoso XL and Calibre DRC/LVS.
- Strong understanding of the state-of-the-art techniques, different circuit topologies and their constraints for the layout implementation.
- Education in Electronics (vocational training or university degree).
Interpersonal skills
- Curious, autonomous, and hands-on.
- You are motivated to play a key role in developing innovative solutions and can adapt to new situations.
- You are a good team player with strong communication skills in English; French or German is an asset.
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community.
- Flexibility, attractive working conditions, and opportunities of development.
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback and that favors a work-life balance.
Our recruitment process
- First screening with one of our expert to assess your technical skills.
- HR interview to get to know you and explain what it is like to be part of the CSEM teams.
- You prepare a case and present to your future team members and top management (depending on the position assessment).
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.

Facing the challenges of our time - Help us grow and be more impactful!
The “Integrated and Wireless Systems” Business Unit , based in Neuchâtel, Switzerland is looking for a seasoned & creative IC Layout Engineer.
Your mission
You will deliver high-quality IC layout solutions for advanced CMOS projects, with a strong emphasis on innovation and ultra-low-power designs.
As part of an experienced layout team, you will lead top-level integration, verification, and documentation through to successful tape-out.
You will work closely with Project Managers, IC designers, and PhD students on floor-planning and layout execution, including acceptance for fab integration.
This role offers the chance to drive best-in-class IC designs and apply cutting-edge layout techniques and tools.
Scope & success criteria : You own top-level integration layout deliverables (GDS, sign-off checks, and documentation) and support block-level work as needed; success is on-time, first-pass-quality tape-out readiness and smooth handoff for fab integration.
Your responsibilities
Main:
- Execute IC layout tasks (occasionally block-level; primarily top-level integration) through acceptance for integration and tape-out.
- Own chip finishing, verification, version control, documentation, and delivery flow.
- Master layout constraints and floor-planning for advanced CMOS designs.
- Apply best practices for ESD and latch-up, and for analog and RF layout.
- Run LVS/DRC/ERC verification, troubleshoot and debug issues, and support tape-out execution.
- Participate actively in projects to ensure smooth IC layout execution (synchronization, tracking, guidelines, quality, etc.).
- Support project managers and designers in defining and executing layout tasks (preparation, resources, effort, and schedule).
- Maintain IC layout expertise and state-of-the-art techniques (ULP SoC, imager, analog, and RF) for advanced CMOS nodes and foundries, including process features/options, tools, and IT flows.
- Ensure work quality meets the company’s IC design and quality flow, and perform reviews/provide feedback.
- Support designers, partners, customers, and project managers on layout (e.g., Virtuoso) and physical verification tools (e.g., Calibre), and share methodology (matching, low-power routing, RF parasitic avoidance, etc.).
Innovation:
- Contribute to CSEM’s innovation efforts through layout execution, technology choices, and modern CAD techniques, with a focus on ultra-low-power ICs (ULP SoC, imager, analog, and RF).
Your profile
Know-how
- 10+ years’ experience as an Analog/RF IC Layout Engineer (nanometer CMOS).
- Strong experience with Cadence (e.g., Virtuoso) and Siemens verification tools (e.g., Calibre) in production flows.
- Strong hands-on layout experience leading top-level activities for mixed-signal ASICs, from specifications and floor-planning to submitting GDS to the foundry.
- Strong experience with Cadence Virtuoso XL and Calibre DRC/LVS.
- Strong understanding of the state-of-the-art techniques, different circuit topologies and their constraints for the layout implementation.
- Education in Electronics (vocational training or university degree).
Interpersonal skills
- Curious, autonomous, and hands-on.
- You are motivated to play a key role in developing innovative solutions and can adapt to new situations.
- You are a good team player with strong communication skills in English; French or German is an asset.
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community.
- Flexibility, attractive working conditions, and opportunities of development.
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback and that favors a work-life balance.
Our recruitment process
- First screening with one of our expert to assess your technical skills.
- HR interview to get to know you and explain what it is like to be part of the CSEM teams.
- You prepare a case and present to your future team members and top management (depending on the position assessment).
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page. Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
The Predictive Analytics group based in Alpnach, is looking for a motivated and skilled R&D Engineer to join our Industrial AI activities. Our team develops intelligent technologies that enable industrial systems to perceive, understand, predict, and optimise complex processes. Combining advanced machine learning, computer vision, multimodal sensing, and optimisation, -technologies, we support industrial partners in addressing challenging problems across manufacturing, transportation, logistics, and other high-value sectors.
Your mission
As an (Senior) R&D Engineer, you will develop innovative solutions that transform industrial data into actionable intelligence. You will work closely with customers and multidisciplinary teams to understand industrial challenges, evaluate state-of-the-art technologies, and deliver solutions from early feasibility studies through to deployment. Depending on experience and seniority, you may also take leadership of projects, contribute to business development, and help shape future research directions.
Your responsibilities
- Design, develop and deploy innovative AI-driven solutions for industrial and research applications involving software and hardware components.
- Develop algorithms for automation, prediction, optimisation, anomaly detection, machine perception, quality assessment, process monitoring and decision support.
- Work with diverse data modalities including time series, images, video, sensor data, spectroscopy data, text and multimodal datasets.
- Design and implement robust software components, data pipelines and AI frameworks suitable for industrial environments.
- Evaluate emerging technologies and transfer research results into practical industrial solutions.
- Contribute to scientific publications, demonstrators, prototypes and technology dissemination activities.
- Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams.
- Participate in project reporting, technical reviews and customer presentations.
- For senior candidates, manage projects including planning, resources, customer interactions and technical coordination.
Your profile
Know-how
- Master's or PhD degree in Computer Science, Neuroinformatics, Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning. Recent graduates with a relevant Master’s thesis are encouraged to apply.
Minimal Requirements
- Proven experience in Python.Computer vision.
- Digital Signal Processing.
- Deep Learning.
- Understanding of industrial machinery.
Nice to have:
- Experience in C#.
- Proven experience in hardware integration.
- Proven experience with classical machine learning and deep learning (publications or relevant industrial experience).
- Experience working with databases (e.g., SQL).
- Experience with high-performance computing enviroments.
- Proven experience in integrating machine learning models into production systems or developing performance-critical applications.
Interpersonal skills
- Dedicated, resilient and innovation driven.
- Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams.
- Autonomous, proactive and results-oriented personality.
- Fluency in German and English required, French beneficial.

jobs.description:
The “Integrated and Wireless Systems” division , based in Neuchâtel, Switzerland is looking for
Your mission
Proactively support the Business Unit’s employees on administrative topics, to facilitate their daily work.
Your responsibilities
- Manage invoices, purchase orders, and expense reports.
- Support the annual financial closing process, including invoices, accruals, and open purchase orders.
- Monitor and verify time reporting records through Timelead.
- Coordinate business travel arrangements and logistics.
- Organize and schedule recruitment interviews.
- Support the onboarding of new employees and maintain headcount records.
- Provide administrative assistance to the Business Unit Manager and Deputy Manager.
- Coordinate customer visits and ensure related logistics are in place.
- Maintain and update customer information in the CRM, including contacts and mailing lists.
- Order business cards and manage office-related administrative requests.
- Handle import and export shipments and coordinate parcel deliveries.
- Manage office supplies and ensure the availability of day-to-day consumables.
- Collaborate closely with colleagues and contribute to the smooth running of administrative activities.
- Scheduling, organization and coordination of various meetings, travels and events
- Coordination of agendas of the management team
Your profile
Know-how
- Commercial Degree and a minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a similar function within an international environment.
- Fluent in French and English (both oral and written), very good knowledge of German is a plus
- Proficient with MS Office & MS Teams (SAP would be an asset)

- Organized, reliable and customer-oriented

jobs.description:
Our Coatings for Energy Devices group develops innovative materials, processes and industrial solutions for next-generation batteries and functional surfaces. The group combines applied research, scale-up and strong partnerships with Swiss and European industrial players to accelerate impact. The group exists within the Sustainable Energy business unit, whose mission is to deliver industrially-relevant solutions to customers, faster.
The position is based in Neuchâtel.
Your mission
Reporting to the BU Leader, your mission is to lead a high-performing battery and coatings materials group (electrodes, electrolytes), with strong research excellence, clear market alignment and durable industrial impact.
- Lead, manage, and (when needed) build a high-performance team with strong industrially-relevant applied research excellence, infrastructure and safety support, and grant-writing excellence.
- Work with the business developer to shape a market-aligned strategy that generates a portfolio of public and industry projects, IP and measurable industrial impact.
- Translate this strategy into a durable financial foundation for the group through industry-funded and public projects; existing grant-writing experience and an industry network are strong differentiators.
- Improve research efficiency by directing investments in automation and ML/AI to accelerate learning rates; prior experience is a plus, and on-the-job support from internal experts is available.
- Contribute to a positive working environment by engaging constructively with other teams across CSEM and with external partners.
Your profile
Know-how
- Ph.D. in a relevant field is required, or an outstanding reputation in battery research.
- Strong expertise in battery materials, with the credibility to lead both scientific direction and industrial relevance.
- Proven experience acquiring and managing industry and public projects in batteries; related coatings technologies is a strong differentiator.
- Demonstrated success building high-performance teams, developing talent and creating a culture of excellence.
- Experience using automation and ML/AI tools to accelerate learning cycles and R&D performance is a strong differentiator; this can also be developed on the job.
Interpersonal skills
- Curious and hands-on, you possess excellent communication, strategy, and negotiation skills.
- You leverage the full potential of your team, providing a structured and positive operational environment.
- You excel in identifying research and market trends, and define core capability roadmaps to meet them.
- You thirst for solving industry problems and translating research findings into real-world impact.
- Fluent in English; knowledge of French and German is a strong differentiator.

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
Your mission
With the support of the steering committee, you will manage Raisehub.swiss, the Swiss European Digital Innovation Hub dedicated to accelerating the adoption of artificial intelligence, robotics and advanced digital technologies by SMEs, start-ups and public sector organisations in Central Switzerland, Ticino and Bern.
As hub manager, you will support the coordination, implementation and further development of the hub activities and you will drive its mission. You will contribute to the successful operation of the one-stop-shop model structured around the four EDIH pillars: innovation ecosystem and networking, training and skills development, test-before-invest, and access to finance. The position contributes to strengthening the digital maturity, competitiveness, AI readiness and trustworthy technology adoption capacity of organisations across the Raisehub.swiss region.
You will work at the interface between CSEM, the Raisehub.swiss consortium partners, end-users, regional economic development actors, public organisations and the other Swiss and European EDIH network stakeholders.
As an AI-focused hub, Raisehub.swiss aims to become a living example of how AI tools can transform daily operations. As Hub Manager, you will have the mission to shape this transformation hands-on exploring, testing and implementing AI-enabled ways of working that make the hub smarter, faster and more efficient.
Your responsibilities
- Manage and support the implementation of Raisehub.swiss activities, work packages, milestones, deliverables.
- Manage the collaboration among the consortium partners and facilitate the interaction between the hub’s consortium and companies, public organizations, and other stakeholders. Act as interface between the hub and the regional industry and public organizations and promote the hub activities and services among them, with particular focus on Central Switzerland.
- Drive the adoption and use of AI tools in the hub operations (website, CRM, administration)
- Support the organization of workshops, training activities, innovation events, networking activities and provide AI and digital coaching to the regional industry.
- Coordinate and execute project planning, monitoring, reporting, financial and administrative follow-up, quality assurance, risk management and compliance with the Swiss and European funding requirements, project documentation.
- Contribute to the continuous strategic development of the EDIH ecosystem – at national and international level
- Contribute to project communication, branding, and marketing activities.
Your profile
Academic background in business, engineering, computer science, digital technologies, innovation management, project management, or a related field.
Know-how
- Experience in stakeholder- and customer-facing activities, networking, outreach, acquisition and onboarding of end-users and customers, with the ability to connect hub services to concrete user needs.
- Experience in professional project management, involving 10+ consortium partners, preferably in publicly funded research and innovation contexts; experience with European projects is an advantage.
- Experience in defining and implementing digital and AI strategies. Prior experience in consulting or engineering services is an advantage.
- Hands-on experience with AI-supported project management and administration tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams meeting intelligence, Planner/Project, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, or comparable platforms.
- Experience with data-driven project monitoring: dashboards, KPI tracking, milestone monitoring, risk detection, budget follow-up and decision-support reporting using tools such as Power BI or comparable solutions.
Interpersonal skills
- Excellent communication skills in Swiss German and English, with Italian as an advantage.
- Proactive, reliable and structured working style.
- Strong organisational awareness and skills.
- Ability to keep an overview in complex multi-partner, multidisciplinary environments.
- Strong collaborative mindset.
- Ability to work independently.
- Take initiative and communicate effectively across disciplines, regions and stakeholder groups.
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community.
- Incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development.
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page. Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

- Hands-on experience with AI-supported project management and administration tools, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams meeting intelligence, Planner/Project, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, or comparable platforms.
- Experience with data-driven project monitoring: dashboards, KPI tracking, milestone monitoring, risk detection, budget follow-up and decision-support reporting using tools such as Power BI or comparable solutions.
Interpersonal skills
- Excellent communication skills in Swiss German and English, with Italian as an advantage.
- Proactive, reliable and structured working style.
- Strong organisational awareness and skills.
- Ability to keep an overview in complex multi-partner, multidisciplinary environments.
- Strong collaborative mindset.
- Ability to work independently.
- Take initiative and communicate effectively across disciplines, regions and stakeholder groups.
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community.
- Incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development.
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page. Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

jobs.description:
Mit Innovation Zukunft gestalten
Werden Sie Teil unseres Erfolgs und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!
Ihre Mission
- Konzeption, Aufbau und Test von Prototypen (Roboter, Kamera-Systeme, Messsysteme)
- Inbetriebnahme und Dokumentation von Industrieanlagen
- Wartung und Debugging beim Endkunden
- Unterstützung bei Deep Learning Projekten (Labeln, Datenaufnahme, Datenbanken, Prozesspipeline, Test & Validierung)
- Durchführung von Messserien
- Konfigurieren, Bestellen und Inbetriebnahme von Systemen (Industrial Vision, Sensoren, High-Performance PCs)
- Unterstützung bei mechanischen Konstruktionen (CAD & Hands On)
Ihre Aufgaben
- Ausführung von Aufgaben gemäß den Anforderungen und Anweisungen der Ingenieurinnen und Ingenieure unter Anwendung verschiedenster Verfahren und Techniken
- Durchführung von Messungen und Tests sowie Analyse und Kommunikation der Ergebnisse
- Wartung von Anlagen und Maschinen sowie Verwaltung von Material- und Produktbestellungen
- Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projekten und Aktivitäten
- Pflege und kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Prozessen
- Mitwirkung an der Sicherstellung und Weiterentwicklung der Qualität einschließlich der zugehörigen Dokumentation
- Gegebenenfalls Verantwortung für die Infrastruktur bzw. das Labor
Ihr Profil
Fachliche Kompetenzen
- Abgeschlossene Grundbildung als Automatiker EFZ oder Elektrotechniker EFZ mit entsprechender Weiterbildung im Bereich Data Analytics oder Informatik oder Mechatronik oder Robotik
Weitere Anforderungen:
- Kenntnisse in Python, C# oder C++ vor Vorteil
- Hands on Arbeiten (Elektronik, Mechanik, Software)
- Embedded Systeme (z.B. Raspberry Pi, ESP32, Arduino)
- Windows & Linux
- Datenbanken (SQL, NoSQL, Time-Series)
- Grundkenntnisse Data analytics
- Grundkenntnisse Regelungs & Steuerungstechnik
- Kenntnisse in additiven Fertigungsverfahren (3D-printing)
- Selbstständige und effiziente Arbeitsweise
- MS Office (Word, Excel, Powerpoint)
- GIT Versionskontrollsystem
- Breitbandiges technisches Verständnis
- Werkstatt/Mechanik sowie CAD Grundkenntnisse
- Selbständiger und methodisch strukturierter Arbeitsstil, bereit Verantwortung zu übernehmen
- Deutsch fliessend (C1+), Englisch (B1+)
Persönliche Kompetenzen
- Bereitschaft zur interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit mit Kollegen aus anderen Fachgebieten
- Sie arbeiten gerne in mehreren interdisziplinären Projekten gleichzeitig und können bedarfsgerecht die Prioritäten verteilen.
- Bereitschaft sich weiterzubilden und sich in neue Anwendungsfelder einzuarbeiten
- Flexibilität, vernetztes Denken und Handeln, Belastbarkeit sowie eine offene, teamorientierte und kommunikative Wesensart
- Entwicklungsprojekte sind Ihnen vertraut und es macht Ihnen Spass, interdisziplinäre Aufgabenstellungen in Teamarbeit zu lösen. Dank Ihrem Improvisationstalent bewältigen Sie auch anspruchsvolle Herausforderungen auf unkomplizierte Art und Weise. Ihre prozesstechnischen Fähigkeiten, Ihre Freude an Teamarbeit und Ihre Kreativität können Sie in einem technologie-orientierten Umfeld voll zum Einsatz bringen
CSEM Mission und Vision
Unser Auftrag ist die Entwicklung und der Transfer von innovativen Technologien in die Schweizer Industrie. Wir lieben es, für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft wichtige Beiträge in den Bereichen Präzisionsfertigung, digitale Technologien und nachhaltige Energie zu leisten. Unsere Stärke ist die Exzellenz unserer Mitarbeitenden aus rund 650 leidenschaftlichen Spezialistinnen und Spezialisten, die sich der Innovation und dem Technologietransfer verschrieben haben. Wir glauben, dass starke Werte die erfolgreiche Entwicklung unserer Organisation sowie die harmonische und ausgewogene Entwicklung aller unserer Mitarbeitenden unterstützen.
Wir sind
- ein einzigartiger Ort an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Industrie, an der Spitze der neuen Technologien.
- ein innovatives, gemeinnütziges, wirkungsorientiertes und mitarbeiterorientiertes Unternehmen.
- ein dynamisches, multidisziplinäres und multikulturelles Umfeld.
Arbeiten @CSEM bedeutet
- Teil einer leidenschaftlichen Gemeinschaft zu sein.
- von unglaublicher Flexibilität, attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen und grossartigen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten profitieren zu können.
- von einer Führungskultur zu profitieren, die auf Vertrauen und Feedback basiert und die eine nachhaltige Work-Life-Balance begünstigt.
Wir verpflichten uns zur Chancengleichheit - unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand, Behinderung und Geschlechtsidentität.
Wir freuen uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Motivationsschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse).

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
The Quantum technologies group within CSEM’s Instrumentation Business Unit, based in Neuchâtel, is currently looking for a PHD Student in Quantum technologies.
Duration : 4 years
Your mission
Contribute to the NCCR Precision research programme by developing high-vacuum MEMS atomic vapor cells for next-generation quantum applications. The PhD project will focus on the design, fabrication and characterization of miniaturized atomic vapor cells enabling compact and robust quantum sensors and precision-measurement systems.
Your Responsbilities
- Develop, fabricate and characterize high-vacuum MEMS atomic vapor cells for quantum sensing, time and frequency, and precision-measurement applications, including materials selection, sealing approaches, vacuum compatibility and alkali-metal filling strategies.
- Perform experimental validation of vapor-cell performance, including vacuum lifetime, thermal behavior, optical properties and suitability for atomic spectroscopy or quantum sensing experiments.
- Work closely with academic partners within the NCCR Precision network and contribute to collaborative research activities.
- Maintain awareness of the state of the art in MEMS vapor cells, vacuum packaging, atomic sensors and precision metrology.
- Document results, prepare scientific publications, contribute to project reporting and present results at internal meetings, workshops and conferences.
Your profile
Master’s degree in physics, microengineering, electrical engineering, materials science, nanotechnology or a related discipline, with a strong motivation to pursue a PhD in experimental quantum technologies and MEMS-based precision devices.
Know how
- Good understanding of experimental physics or engineering principles relevant to miniaturized quantum devices and precision measurement.
- Ideally, the candidate has knowledge or hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas:
-MEMS design, microfabrication, cleanroom processing or wafer level packaging Vacuum technology, hermetic sealing, materials compatibility and residual gas control
-Atomic vapor cells, alkali-metal handling, optical spectroscopy or laser-based experiments
-Quantum sensing, atomic clocks, magnetometry, time and frequency metrology or precision measurement
-Experimental data analysis and simulation using Python orequivalent tools
-CAD or multiphysics simulation tools are considered an asset
- Previous experience in a research laboratory, cleanroom environment or collaborative research project is considered an asset.
Interpersonal skills
- Strong scientific curiosity and motivation for experimental research
- Rigorous, autonomous and well-organized working style
- Ability to work in a multidisciplinary environment combining physics, microtechnology, materials and systems engineering
- Good communication skills and willingness to collaborate with academic and industrial partners
- Analytical mindset, creativity and perseverance in solving experimental challenges
- Fluency in English; knowledge of French and/or German is an asset
CSEM mission and values
Our mission is the development and transfer of innovative technologies to the Swiss industry. Our objective is to make an impact on our customers and on society at large in the fields of precision manufacturing, digital technologies and sustainable energy. Our strength is the excellence of our people, about 650 passionate specialists dedicated to innovation and technology transfer. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community
- Incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback and that favors a work-life balance
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page.
Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

Aufbau und Leitung der gemeinsamen Aktivitäten von CSEM und HSLU im Bereich Collective Human Robot Intelligence. Die Stelleninhaberin oder der Stelleninhaber entwickelt anwendungsorientierte Kompetenzen, initiiert und leitet gemeinsame Forschungs- und Innovationsprojekte und stärkt die Zusammenarbeit mit Industrie, Wissenschaft und öffentlichen Partnern. Damit trägt die Funktion zur technologischen Wettbewerbsfähigkeit und Innovationskraft der Zentralschweiz bei.
Ihre Aufgaben
- Anwendungsorientierte Forschungstätigkeit in Themengebiet der mobilen Robotik
- Akquisition und Leitung von Forschungs- und Dienstleistungsprojekten mit Beteiligung von HSLU – Informatik und CSEM
- Positionierung, Koordination und Ausbau gemeinsamer Aktivitäten zwischen HSLU – Informatik und CSEM
- Lehre auf Bachelor- und Masterlevel
- Betreuung von Studierendenarbeiten (Bachelor- und Masterlevel)
- Möglichkeit zur Mitarbeit an Weiterbildungsangeboten (z.B. CAS)
- Nationale und internationale Vernetzung im Themengebiet der mobilen Robotik

Fachliche Kompetenzen
- Hochschulabschluss mit Promotion
- Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in Akquisition und Leitung von Forschungs- und Dienstleistungsprojekten
- Fundierte Management- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
- Umfassender wissenschaftlicher Leistungsausweis
- Praktisches und theoretisches Wissen sowie mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung mit Robotik-Anwendungen

- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
The Predictive Analytics group is offering a student project or internship focused on developing an augmented reality system for detecting and identifying parts on an industrial shop floor.
The proposed system will combine computer vision, object tracking, and 3D visualization to recognize parts in the worker’s environment and present relevant information directly through an augmented reality interface. Depending on the available production data, the displayed information may include part category, quantity and customer-order associated with the detected parts
The system will support workers in locating and counting parts, tracking customer orders, and collecting the information required.. The project will investigate different hardware and algorithmic options for robust detection and identification under realistic shop-floor conditions, including changes in viewpoint, lighting, occlusion, part arrangement, and background.
The final outcome will be a validated proof-of-concept demonstrator that integrates visual perception, part tracking, data retrieval, and an intuitive augmented reality visualization.
The project is intended for a minimum duration of six months and requires regular on-site work in Alpnach, Switzerland.
Your responsibilities
- Define the system requirements and representative industrial use cases together with the project team.
- Test a variety of different AR hardware and libraries
- Set up and document an experimental environment with representative industrial parts and shop-floor conditions.
- Acquire and annotate image or video data for part detection, tracking, and identification.
- Develop and evaluate computer-vision methods for detecting industrial parts.
- Design an augmented reality interface that visualizes part information clearly.
- Assess robustness under changes in viewpoint, lighting, occlusion, part arrangement, and background.
- Develop a proof-of-concept demonstrator and validate it through realistic industrial experiments.
- Document the implementation and results and communicate findings to the Predictive Analytics team.
- Assist the team with various tasks.
Your profile
Bachelor's or Master's studies in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, Microengineering, or a related field, with a focus on computer vision, augmented reality, or interactive systems.
Know-how
- Strong programming skills in Python
- Good knowledge of computer vision, particularly object detection, tracking, and identification
- Familiarity with augmented reality concepts and development frameworks
- Knowledge of 3D computer graphics, coordinate systems, camera geometry, and visualization
- Experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks
- Familiarity with cameras, sensors, or AR hardware is an advantage
- Familiarity with Git and Linux is an advantage
- Interest in hands-on industrial experimentation and user-oriented system development
- Strong English communication skills; German is an advantage
Interpersonal skills
- Driven and motivated
- Practical, hands-on working style
- Good communication skills
- Highly collaborative
- Flexible and adaptable thinking and operating style
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community.
- Incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development.
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback and that favors a work-life balance.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page. Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

jobs.title: Internship in Agentic AI (F/M/D)
jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
We are looking for a passionate intern in Agentic AI.
The internship duration is minimum 6 months.
For this position the enrollment in a Computer Science or Engineering program at ETH is mandatory .
The Predictive Analytics group is offering an internship focused on exploring how effectively LLM-powered agents can perform data analysis tasks using both real customer data and synthetic datasets.
Your mission
You will work closely with our PhD student, who is affiliated with the Computer Science Department at ETH Zurich. For highly motivated students, the internship may lead to a publication at a top-tier conference such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, or AAAI.
Enrollment in a Computer Science or Engineering program at ETH is mandatory.
Your responsibilities
- Contribute to the development of an AI agent designed to analyze and interpret industrial data for our clients.
- Design and implement proof-of-concept solutions and demonstrators for various predictive analytics projects in collaboration with the team based in Alpnach.
- Engage in academic research activities together with our PhD student, advancing knowledge and innovation in the field of LLM and Agentic AI.
- Assist the team in various tasks.
Your profile
Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Neuroinformatics, Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and Deep Learning.
Know-how
Requirements:
- Ability to work on-site in Alpnach, Switzerland, at least three times a week.
- Strong proficiency in Python.
- Enrollment in a Computer Science or Engineering program at ETH.
- Familiarity with Git and Linux (Bash, SSH, etc.)
- Theoretical knowledge of machine learning (e.g., completion of Introduction to Machine Learning or equivalent)
- Strong background in Computer Science
- Demonstrated research experience Large Language Models (LLMs) or computer vision
- Proficiency in Python
- Strong English-speaking skills required, German speaking skills a plus
Preferred qualifications (one or more):
- Demonstrated experience in building and deploying actively used applications.
- Proven experience with agentic applications.
- Research experience in machine learning or computer vision (e.g., publications).
- Experience with customer-facing tasks (presentations, slides, emails).
- German language proficiency (C1).
Interpersonal skills
- Driven and motivated
- Good communication skills
- Highly collaborative
- Flexible and adaptable thinking / operating style

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
The Predictive Analytics group is offering a student project or internship to develop and validate an adaptive equipment-intelligence framework for semiconductor manufacturing using machine telemetry and high-frequency sensing.
Using semiconductor die bonding as the experimental platform, the project will investigate whether acoustic emission and other sensor signals can provide robust information about equipment and process state across changing recipes and operating conditions.
Machine-learning methods will be developed for:
- Quality prediction
- Anomaly detection and virtual metrology, with emphasis on generalization across recipes and operating conditions
- Uncertainty-aware adaptation using limited data from new process conditions
The project will quantify which sensing modalities and signal representations remain informative under process changes and determine how much new data is required to adapt the monitoring system to a new operating regime.
The project is intended for a minimum duration of six months and requires regular on-site work in Alpnach, Switzerland.
Your responsibilities
- Design and instrument an experimental setup for semiconductor die-bonding measurements.
- Acquire, synchronize, document, and preprocess machine telemetry, acoustic-emission data, and other high-frequency sensor signals.
- Develop machine-learning approaches for quality prediction, anomaly detection, and virtual metrology.
- Evaluate the robustness and generalization of sensing modalities and signal representations across recipes and operating conditions.
- Develop uncertainty-aware adaptation methods using limited data from new process conditions.
- Document methods and results and communicate findings to the Predictive Analytics team.
- Assist the team in various tasks
Your profile
Bachelor's or Master's studies in Computer Science, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Microengineering, or a related engineering field, with a focus on machine learning.
Know-how
- Good knowledge of machine learning and engineering fundamentals
- Proficiency in Python
- Familiarity with time-series and sensor data
- Interest in industrial experimentation
- Hands-on skills to build and instrument an experimental setup
- Familiarity with Git and Linux is an advantage
- Knowledge of acoustic sensing or virtual metrology is an advantage
- Strong English communication skills; German is an advantage
Interpersonal skills
- Driven and motivated
- Practical, hands-on working style
- Good communication skills
- Highly collaborative
- Flexible and adaptable thinking and operating style

Help us grow and be more impactful !
The Human Resources team based in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, is currently looking for a : Training & HR Event Coordinator at 60%.
Your mission
Under the responsibility of the CPO, the Training & HR Event Coordinator designs, coordinates and ensures the operational excellence of the training offer and selected HR events. Your responsibilities
- Build and maintain the annual training plan based on the training strategy, develop the training catalogue in coordination with the Learning & Development Manager and ensure alignment with identified development needs.
- Organize training sessions, manage scheduling, registrations, attendance tracking, certifications and the day-to-day administration of learning activities.
- Organize and coordinate the Welcome breakfast & Welcome@CSEM training program to support the onboarding and integration of new hires within the organization.

- Search for, select and coordinate external training providers, manage supplier relationships, support budget monitoring, invoice processing and related administrative follow-up and regularly informs the Learning & Development Manager on the budget status.
- Ensure the quality of training activities by collecting immediate and delayed feedback, monitoring learning impact and proposing improvements to the training offer and processes.
- Produce reports, track key indicators and provide reliable data to support the operational steering of Learning activities.

Know-how
- Experience in training coordination, learning administration, HR event coordination, HR administration, LMS management or a comparable role.

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
Our dynamic and successful Business Unit dedicated to Micro & Nano Systems, based in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, is looking for a business-savvy, visionary and communicative Business Unit Leader.
Your responsibilities
Strategic
- Define and deploy the strategy of the Business Unit in alignment with the company’s strategy
- Proactively participate to the Executive Committee
- Steer the relationship with local stakeholders (Canton NE, EPFL, Industry associations)
- Define the research program and technology roadmap activities of the BU
- Define the business development strategy and programs
- Drive the business acquisition and ensure a good relationship with all internal and external partners
- Set the BU Communication and Marketing activities in collaboration with the central Business Development and MARCOM team
- Proactively support the internal collaboration with the other BU Leaders
Financial
- Define, control and ensure the BU’s budget and financial reporting
- Manage and approve the project portfolio and all BU investments
- Drive and supervise the Microfabrication operations and Cleanroom strategic investments in concert with local stakeholders
Quality management/ISO
- Ensure that the BU meets the company’s Quality standards (ISO Standards 9001 and 14001)
- Supervise and ensure the Project delivery and Microfabrication quality commitment to clients
- Supervise external audits and evaluate external audit reports, in collaboration with the Quality Managers
Human Resources/Management
- Lead a BU of over 80 experts and engineers
- Directly manage a team of 8 senior leaders (Deputy BU Leader, Group Leaders, Research, Business Development, Operations and Finance Managers)
- Define annual goals and ensure the development of all employees at BU level, in particular the development of young talents
- Maintain a motivating and balanced high-tech working environment
- In collaboration with the VP Human Resources and HRBP, approve all hirings and promotions, and ensure the equity of salaries
Relationships
- Responsible for the political networking and contracts in the Canton of Neuchatel and other institutional stakeholders
Your Profile
Know-how
- At least a Master’s degree in Engineering, PhD or MBA as an asset
- International experience in high-tech industry is highly desirable
- At least 10 years experience in senior management position in high-tech industry – Semiconductors, Electronics components & devices, Photonics, Micro Systems
- High level overview and understanding of the global high-tech industry
- Business acumen and understanding of industry macro trends
- Good understanding of Micro Systems driven application domains as medical devices, electronic systems, instrumentation, energy, and emerging one as quantum, nano-tech, space-tech, Additive Manufacturing
- Strong capabilities to drive financial aspects and work closely with CFO office
- Proven experience in managing and motivating teams of highly skilled technical experts
- Fluent in English and French
Interpersonal skills
- An inspiring leader with excellent listening skills and the ability to build trust among customers, partners and collaborators
- Ability to define a vision and to provide clear directions and priorities to execute on it
- Strong analytical skills combined with structured and critical thinking
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills with industry, academic and institutional stakeholder
- Proven networking skills, with a strong network in Switzerland, EU and worldwide
- Open-minded and creative thinking
- Able to work under pressure
- Customer- and service-oriented mindset and solution-driven approach
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- being part of a passionate community
- incredible flexibility, attractive working conditions, and great opportunities of development
- benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback and that favors a work-life balance
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.
We look forward to receiving your complete application file via (CV, cover letter, certificates & diplomas) our job page. Preference will be given to professionals applying directly.

jobs.title: LPBF Expert (F/M/D) 100%
jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time
Help us grow and be more impactful!
The Additive Manufacturing and Component Reliability Group within CSEM’s Micro and Nano Systems Business Unit in Neuchâtel is seeking an experienced LPBF expert to strengthen its existing team. The preferred start date is as soon as possible, subject to the successful candidate’s availability and mutual agreement.
Your mission
Your mission will be to strengthen CSEM’s LPBF team and advance the additive manufacturing of single- and multi-metal components. You will take ownership of LPBF printing activities and play a key role in successfully delivering additive manufacturing projects. Drawing on your mechanical engineering expertise, you will help solving complex industrial challenges and contribute to innovation in manufacturing processes.
Your responsibilities
The role encompasses the full scope of LPBF activities.
The primary focus is the hands-on operation of three complementary LPBF systems, requiring a high level of technical expertise.
Additional responsibilities include:
- Scientific contribution to LPBF activities and projects
- Delivering high-quality technical documentation and progress reports for industrial customers.
- Maintaining an active on-site presence, delivery of laboratory tours, and supervision of students undertaking semester projects and internships.
Your profile
Know-how
- Proven hands-on experience in operating LPBF systems.
- A strong scientific background, demonstrated by one of the following:
- PhD in a relevant field, with a background in mechanical engineering,
or
- Master’s degree in a relevant field, combined with several years of professional experience and a background or practical experience in mechanical engineering.
- Good communications skills in German, French, and English.
Interpersonal skills
- Curious and creative, with a strong desire to innovate across disciplines and find non-conventional engineering solutions.
- Hands-on, proactive, and results driven.
- Able to work both independently and in multidisciplinary teams.
- Strong organizational skills.
Applications must be submitted by 30 October 2026.

jobs.title: LPBF Experte (W/M/D) 100%
jobs.description:
Mit Innovation Zukunft gestalten
Werden Sie Teil unseres Erfolgs und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft!
Die Gruppe Additive Fertigung und Bauteilzuverlässigkeit von CSEM in Neuenburg sucht eine erfahrene LPBF-Fachperson zur Verstärkung des bestehenden Teams. Der Stellenantritt erfolgt vorzugsweise so bald wie möglich, abhängig von der Verfügbarkeit der ausgewählten Person und nach gegenseitiger Vereinbarung.
Ihre Mission
Ihre Mission besteht darin, das LPBF-Team von CSEM zu verstärken und die additive Fertigung von Bauteilen aus einem oder mehreren Metallen weiterzuentwickeln. Sie übernehmen die Verantwortung für die LPBF-Druckaktivitäten und spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der erfolgreichen Umsetzung von Projekten im Bereich der additiven Fertigung. Mit Ihrer Expertise im Maschinenbau helfen Sie, komplexe industrielle Herausforderungen zu lösen und innovative Fertigungsprozesse zu entwickeln.
Ihre Aufgaben
Die Position umfasst das gesamte Spektrum der LPBF-Aktivitäten.
Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf der praktischen Bedienung von drei sich ergänzenden LPBF-Systemen, die ein hohes Mass an technischem Fachwissen erfordert.
Zu den weiteren Aufgaben gehören:
- Wissenschaftliche Mitwirkung an LPBF-Aktivitäten und -Projekten.
- Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen und Berichte über den Projektfortschritt für Industriekunden.
- Regelmässige Präsenz vor Ort, Durchführung von Laborführungen sowie Betreuung von Studierenden im Rahmen von Semesterarbeiten und Praktika.
Ihr Profil
Fachliche Kompetenzen
- Nachgewiesene praktische Erfahrung in der Bedienung von LPBF-Systemen.
- Fundierter wissenschaftlicher Hintergrund, nachgewiesen durch eine der folgenden Qualifikationen:
– Doktorat in einem relevanten Fachgebiet mit Hintergrund im Maschinenbau
oder
– Masterabschluss in einem relevanten Fachgebiet, kombiniert mit mehrjähriger Berufserfahrung sowie einem Hintergrund oder praktischer Erfahrung im Maschinenbau.
- Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch, Französisch und Englisch.
Persönliche Kompetenzen
- Neugierig und kreativ, mit einem ausgeprägten Innovationsgeist über Fachgrenzen hinweg und der Fähigkeit, unkonventionelle technische Lösungen zu entwickeln.
- Praxisorientiert, proaktiv und ergebnisorientiert.
- Fähigkeit, sowohl selbstständig als auch in multidisziplinären Teams zu arbeiten.
- Ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten.
Bewerbungsschluss ist der 30. Oktober 2026.
Mission und Werte von CSEM
Wir glauben an eine Zukunft, die GEMEINSAM erdacht, geteilt und gestaltet wird.
Bei CSEM entwickeln wir nicht nur Innovationen – wir entwerfen Technologien, die die Zukunft prägen.
Seit 1984 ist unser Ziel unverändert: Wissenschaft und Technologie zum Nutzen der Gesellschaft einzusetzen. Heute arbeiten mehr als 650 Menschen an verschiedenen Standorten in der Schweiz für unsere Mission: erstklassige Lösungen in den Bereichen digitale Technologien, Präzisionsfertigung und nachhaltige Energiesysteme zu entwickeln und zu transferieren. Damit befähigen wir die Schweizer Industrie, innovativ und wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben.
Unsere Stärke liegt in der Exzellenz unserer Mitarbeitenden. Wir sind überzeugt, dass starke Werte sowohl die erfolgreiche Entwicklung unserer Organisation als auch die harmonische und ausgewogene Entwicklung aller Mitarbeitenden fördern.
Wir sind
- Ein einzigartiger Ort an der Schnittstelle zwischen Forschung und Industrie und an der Spitze neuer Technologien
- Ein innovatives, nicht gewinnorientiertes und von den Mitarbeitenden geprägtes Unternehmen
- Ein dynamisches, multidisziplinäres und multikulturelles Umfeld
- Ein engagiertes Team, das Lösungen für die Energieherausforderungen einer nachhaltigen Welt ermöglicht
Arbeiten bei CSEM bedeutet
- Teil einer engagierten Gemeinschaft zu sein.
- Flexibilität, attraktive Arbeitsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
- Von einem Führungsstil zu profitieren, der auf Vertrauen und Feedback basiert und die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatleben fördert.
Wir bekennen uns zur Chancengleichheit bei der Beschäftigung – unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsangehörigkeit, Zivilstand, Behinderung oder Geschlechtsidentität.

jobs.description:
Facing the challenges of our time - Help us grow and be more impactful!
Your mission
Help create engineering tools that combine mechanics, computation and AI to make the design of complex optomechatronic systems faster, more rigorous and more reusable.
CSEM and the Engineering Design and Computing Laboratory of ETH Zurich are seeking a doctoral researcher to investigate how AI and advanced computational methods can support the design of high-performance optomechatronic systems. The research will be anchored in compliant mechanisms, where performance emerges from tightly coupled geometry, material behaviour, actuation, sensing, manufacturing and verification constraints.
The ambition is not to treat AI as a black box. You will develop scientifically grounded methods that combine physics-based models, simulation data and engineering knowledge, and make their predictions traceable, testable and useful to engineers.
Research focus
The project will build on the outcomes of Guilain Lang’s doctoral thesis, “CAM2S2: Compliant AM Mechanisms Systematic Synthesizer” [ link to the online thesis ], which established a systematic framework for translating requirements into compliant mechanism designs. The new research will critically assess and selectively reuse, adapt or extend the methods and tools developed in CAM2S2, without being constrained to retain the complete existing framework. From this foundation, it will develop and validate AI-assisted methods to derive engineering insight from requirements, explore broader solution spaces and generate reusable models for mechanism and optomechatronic system design. The exact thesis plan will be refined with the selected candidate and the supervisors. Expected research directions include:
- AI-assisted interpretation of requirements to identify critical design drivers, sensitive parameters, conflicts and uncertainty.
- Traceable use of scientific literature and CSEM engineering knowledge, including models, test results and lessons learned.
- Inverse and multi-objective design methods that connect required performance to geometry, material choices and manufacturing constraints.
- Extension of mechanism synthesis beyond a limited set of topologies, including variable cross-sections and alternative manufacturing routes.
- Physics-informed surrogate or reduced-order models for nonlinear stiffness, stress, buckling, parasitic motion and other key mechanism properties.
- Automated generation of design-of-experiment campaigns using finite element models and computational methods.
- Implementation and validation on representative compliant optomechatronic demonstrators.
Your responsibilities
- Formulate focused research questions and establish robust benchmarks against existing analytical, numerical and engineering workflows.
- Develop computational models, algorithms and research software with reproducible data and version control practices.
- Design numerical experiments, critically assess model validity and quantify uncertainty.
- Work closely with specialists in mechanics, systems engineering, AI, manufacturing and testing at CSEM and ETH Zurich.
- Validate selected methods against higher-fidelity simulations and experimental evidence.
- Publish in leading peer-reviewed journals and present at international conferences.
- Transfer useful methods into engineering tools and document them so that they can be understood, challenged and reused.
Your profile
Know-how
Essential
- Master's degree in microtechnology or mechanical engineering, computational science and engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, robotics, or a closely related field.
- Strong foundation in computational mechanics and numerical modelling, including finite element analysis.
- Understanding of the architecture and development of multidisciplinary optomechatronic or mechatronic systems.
- Ability to develop and assess computational methods beyond routine use of commercial FEM software.
- Solid programming skills, preferably in Python and/or a compiled scientific-computing language.
- Rigorous scientific reasoning, independence, creativity and the ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English.
Strong assets
- Background in machine learning, artificial intelligence or data-driven modelling, with the ability to connect these methods to physical systems.
- Experience with surrogate modelling, optimisation, uncertainty quantification, reduced-order modelling, differentiable simulation or scientific machine learning.
- Knowledge of compliant mechanisms, nonlinear structural mechanics, mechanism synthesis or topology optimisation.
- Experience in design for additive manufacturing. DfAM is a major advantage, although the project will not be limited to DfAM.
- Experience with CAD, parametric modelling, experimental validation or the development of engineering software.
What we offer
- A doctoral project at the intersection of fundamental methods and demanding real-world engineering applications.
- Joint supervision by CSEM and Prof. Kristina Shea's Engineering Design and Computing Laboratory at ETH Zurich.
- Access to CSEM expertise, engineering heritage, simulation and test capabilities in precision mechanisms and optomechatronic systems.
- A multidisciplinary and international environment with close interaction between researchers and engineers.
- The opportunity to publish scientific results while translating research into methods with direct engineering value.
- Attractive employment conditions and access to the ETH Zurich doctoral ecosystem, subject to the applicable admission and approval requirements.
CSEM mission and values
We believe in a future that is imagined, shared, and created TOGETHER.
At CSEM, we don’t just innovate, we envision technologies that shape tomorrow.
Since 1984, our purpose has remained constant: to harness science and technology for the benefit of society. Today, with over 650 people across Switzerland, we remain committed to our mission: to develop and transfer world-class solutions in digital technologies, precision manufacturing, and sustainable energy systems. In doing so, we empower Swiss industry to innovate and remain competitive.
Our strength is the excellence of our people. We believe that strong values support the successful development of our organization as well as the harmonious and balanced development of all our employees.
We are
- A unique place between research and industry at the cutting edge of new technologies
- An innovative, non-profit, and employee-driven company
- A dynamic, multidisciplinary, and multicultural environment
- A solar team focused on enabling solutions to energy challenges for a sustainable world
Working@CSEM means
- Being part of a passionate community
- Flexibility, attractive working conditions, and opportunities of development
- Benefit from a management style based on trust & feedback
Please submit:
- A concise motivation letter explaining why this research question fits your background and ambitions.
- Curriculum vitae, degree certificates and academic transcripts.
- A short description or link to one research, software or engineering project that best demonstrates your contribution.
- Contact details for at least two academic or professional referees.
In your motivation letter, briefly describe how you would combine physics-based simulation and machine learning without losing traceability or engineering credibility.
Applications will be evaluated on scientific potential, depth of fundamentals, evidence of independent problem solving and alignment with the interdisciplinary nature of the project. The position will be primarily based at CSEM in Neuchâtel. The doctoral researcher will also spend time at ETH Zurich, as required by the research activities and the collaboration with the Engineering Design and Computing Laboratory. The project will be conducted as an external doctoral thesis under ETH Zurich supervision, subject to formal university approval and admission.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity.

The research will be anchored in compliant mechanisms, where performance emerges from tightly coupled geometry, material behaviour, actuation, sensing, manufacturing and verification constraints.
The ambition is not to treat AI as a black box. You will develop scientifically grounded methods that combine physics-based models, simulation data and engineering knowledge, and make their predictions traceable, testable and useful to engineers.
